companyIntro.name: Nimbus Digital

companyIntro.culture: Sprint-disciplined and blameless-retro focused. People here are expected to raise blockers loudly and early.

projectBackground.name: Service Desk Operations
projectBackground.context: Email is down for a department while a password reset queue grows and an SLA report is due.

manager.name: Jonas Weber
manager.note: Users don't care about root cause, they care about being back to work. Fix first, find the cause afterwards.

assignment.title: Clear the queue and keep users informed
assignment.brief: Prioritise by impact and urgency, calculate SLA compliance and write a clear user update.

documents.name: Ticket Queue
documents.note: Email outage (50 users), password reset (1 user), printer jam (1 user).

documents.name: Problem Record
documents.note: Repeated email outages after nightly patching.

tasks.title: Prioritisation
options: A password reset for one user
tasks.reasoning: Priority comes from impact and urgency.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: SLA Compliance
tasks.prompt: 180 of 200 tickets were resolved within SLA. What is SLA compliance?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Incident vs Problem
tasks.prompt: Repeated email outages after nightly patching should be handled as:
options: A problem record to find and fix the root cause
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Good Ticket Handling
options: Update the user at agreed intervals
tasks.reasoning: Documentation and communication make support reliable.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: User Update
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-4 sentence update to the affected email users.
tasks.modelAnswer: We're aware that email is unavailable for the Finance department and are working to restore it. The cause appears linked to last night's patch; engineers are rolling it back. We expect service back within 45 minutes and will update you at 10:30. In the meantime you can use the web mail address sent separately. Thank you for your patience.
tasks.reasoning: A good update acknowledges, explains simply, gives a time and a workaround.
tasks.mistake: Technical jargon or silence frustrates users.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Outage Nobody Explained
caseStudy.background: Email failed for four hours and users heard nothing. Staff made workarounds that exposed data, and complaints reached the CEO.
caseStudy.budget: Lost productivity and a security review
questions: What should the first message include?
caseStudy.solution: Nimbus assigned an incident communicator and updates every 30 minutes.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Communication is part of the fix.

quiz.q: In the case study complaints grew because:

prompts: How do you stay calm with an angry user?
What would you automate on a service desk?
How do you decide to raise a problem record?
